tasks.title: Create the module skeleton and the Makefile quality gate
steps: Create go.mod with `module github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib` and `go 1.27`, with no replace directive and no requires yet. The uuid and sqlite requires are added with the jobqueue import (task 3). Do not commit a go.work
Add `doc.go` is NOT created here (task 6 owns it). If `go build ./...` fails on an empty module, make the targets tolerate it (`go build ./...` with no packages is fine)

Write the Makefile with the targets help, build (`go build ./...`), test (`go test ./... -count=1`), test-short (`go test -short ./...`), coverage, fmt (gofmt -w over tracked Go files, via `git ls-files '*.go'`), vet (`go vet ./...`), lint, check (fmt vet lint test-short, in that order, stopping at the first failure), check-release (fmt vet lint test), doc, tidy (`go mod tidy`), clean and api-golden. Use .PHONY and no MODULES loop
lint: if `command -v golangci-lint` succeeds run `golangci-lint run`, else print `golangci-lint not installed: lint skipped` to stdout and exit 0

doc: discover public packages (go list, skipping /internal/ paths, docs, examples, testdata), compute the golden name (directory relative to the module root with `/` replaced by `_`; root is `aflib`), and write `go doc -all <importpath>` to docs/generated/<name>.txt, creating the directory first
api-golden: `go test -run TestExportedAPI . -update`

Write the three tests as one-off handoff checks run by hand: TS-01-40 with `make -n <target>` for every target, TS-01-41 in a scratch copy with an injected vet failure (confirm no later step runs), TS-01-42 with a PATH lacking golangci-lint. Do not commit tests of Makefile content (steering forbids it)
Run `make check` and confirm it exits 0 on the skeleton
done_when: `make -n` succeeds for all 14 targets
`make lint` exits 0 with a skip message when golangci-lint is absent from PATH

tasks.title: Import issuex from agent-fox at 84fb9b4 as its own commit
steps: Clone https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agent-fox into a temp dir outside this repository and resolve 84fb9b4 to its full 40-character hash with `git rev-parse`. If the clone or the commit cannot be fetched, STOP: commit nothing under issuex/, and report the unreachable commit in the handoff (01-REQ-2.5). Never reconstruct from memory, docs or another commit

Extract with `git archive <fullhash> issuex | tar -x -C <this repo>` so every file, including testdata/ and non-Go files, lands under issuex/ at the same relative path. Never copy from the working tree

Rewrite only import-path lines in `_test.go` files: `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agent-fox/issuex` (and sub-paths) to `github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib/issuex`. Leave package clauses `issuex` and `issuex_test` and all non-test files untouched
Run `go build ./issuex/...` and `go vet ./issuex/...`; issuex is standard-library only so go.mod needs no changes. Do not edit copied code if a problem appears: leave it for task 4/5 (findings rules)
Run `go test -short -count=1 -v ./issuex/...`; confirm exit 0 and that the GitLab smoke test is SKIP (TS-01-11)

Verify by one-off scripts run outside the repo: TS-01-7 (`git ls-tree -r <fullhash> issuex` path set equals issuex/ path set; non-test .go files byte-equal to `git show`), TS-01-8 (line-diff each test file; only import lines differ), TS-01-10 (run the fetch+archive procedure against `file:///nonexistent` in a scratch copy: non-zero exit, no issuex/ created)

Create one commit containing only issuex/ and any go.mod/go.sum change. The message is conventional (`feat(issuex): import from agent-fox`) and names https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agent-fox and the full hash. No Co-Authored-By. Verify with `git show --stat` (TS-01-9)
done_when: `go test -short -count=1 ./issuex/...` exits 0
the issuex commit message contains the full 40-character source hash

tasks.title: Import jobqueue from hub at ce8e1b8 and pin uuid and sqlite
steps: Clone https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/hub into a temp dir outside this repository and resolve ce8e1b8 to its full hash. If it cannot be fetched STOP: commit nothing under jobqueue/ and report it in the handoff (01-REQ-3.5)
Read hub's go.mod at that hash with `git show <fullhash>:go.mod` and note the exact versions of github.com/google/uuid and modernc.org/sqlite

Extract with `git archive <fullhash> internal/jobqueue`, placing every file under jobqueue/ at the same relative path (strip the `internal/` prefix, e.g. `tar -x --strip-components=1` into a temp dir then move)
Rewrite only import lines in `_test.go` files: `github.com/agent-fox-dev/hub/internal/jobqueue` to `github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib/jobqueue`. Non-test files stay byte-identical

Add the two requires at hub's exact versions (`go get github.com/google/uuid@<v> modernc.org/sqlite@<v>`, then `go mod tidy`, accepting `// indirect` additions). Confirm go.mod has no replace and go.sum exists and is tracked

Run `go build ./...`, `go vet ./jobqueue/...` and `go test -short -count=1 ./jobqueue/...`; exit 0 required. If a non-test file imports another package of hub, STOP without copying it (01-REQ-4.2). If a test imports a hub helper or another module, leave handling to task 4

Verify with one-off scripts run outside the repo: TS-01-12 (path set and byte identity against `git show`), TS-01-13 (only import-line diffs), TS-01-15 (fetch from `file:///nonexistent` fails, no jobqueue/ created), TS-01-16 (parser.ImportsOnly over jobqueue: non-test imports are stdlib or uuid, only _test.go imports modernc.org/sqlite), TS-01-1 (go.mod module/go lines, pinned versions equal hub's, no replace, go.sum tracked, go.work untracked)

Create one commit containing only jobqueue/, go.mod and go.sum. The message (`feat(jobqueue): import from hub`) names https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/hub and the full hash. Verify with `git show --stat` (TS-01-14)
done_when: `go test -short -count=1 ./jobqueue/...` exits 0
go.mod versions of uuid and modernc.org/sqlite equal hub's at ce8e1b8

tasks.title: Apply the import findings rules, verify the clean-checkout build, and write the erratum
steps: Run `gofmt -l .`, `go vet ./...` and `go test -short -count=1 ./...`. For each failure apply the fixed rules: a gofmt/vet failure gets the smallest edit that does not change an exported declaration; a test helper from a source module is copied into `internal/<helper>/` so test edits stay import-path-only; an extra test-only module is added to go.mod and recorded as a ruling in docs/architecture.md; an environmental failure is fixed outside the test file. No test may be deleted, skipped, t.Skip-gated or weakened. If a non-test file imports another package of its source module, STOP, do not edit or copy, and report it as blocking

Compare the sets of Test*, Fuzz* and Example* function names per package with the source commits (TS-01-18) by a one-off script; scan non-test imports for github.com/agent-fox-dev/agent-fox and github.com/agent-fox-dev/hub paths (TS-01-19, including a fixture file that must be reported), and test imports for the same (TS-01-20)
Check TS-01-21: list direct requires beyond uuid and sqlite and where each is imported; if none, the erratum says so
Check TS-01-23 and TS-01-24: list every non-test file differing from its source, confirm each is in the erratum, confirm every testdata path the tests open exists

Run the clean-checkout checks in a fresh `git clone` of this repo into a temp dir (TS-01-4: `go build ./...` and `go test -short ./...`; TS-01-6: unset GITHUB_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN, GITHUB_API_URL, GITLAB_API_URL and the GitLab smoke variable named in the copied test, run `go test -short -v ./...`, confirm the smoke test is SKIP). Run `go list -m all` and confirm no path starts with github.com/agent-fox-dev/hub, github.com/agent-fox-dev/agent-fox or the AgentKit module path (TS-01-5)

Write docs/errata/01_import_issuex_and_jobqueue.md with: source repository and full hash for each package (agent-fox 84fb9b4 resolved, hub ce8e1b8 resolved); an explanation that requirement IDs in copied test names and comments (e.g. `10-REQ-6.E3`, `01-REQ-4.8`) refer to the source repositories' spec archives, not this repository's specs, even where numbers collide; every finding (edits, helpers, extra modules, env fixes) or the statement that there were no findings; and the note that lint exclusions are added in the next task
Run `make check` and confirm exit 0 (lint may be skipped)
done_when: `go test -short -count=1 ./...` exits 0 in a fresh clone
the erratum exists and names both full hashes

tasks.title: Add .golangci.yml from hub with path-scoped issuex exclusions
steps: Extract hub's `.golangci.yml` with `git show <hub full hash>:.golangci.yml` and copy it to this repository's root
Remove every rule that names a hub path; keep everything else byte-for-byte

Run `golangci-lint run` (install it if absent for this check). `jobqueue` must pass as it did in hub. For each finding in issuex add a path-scoped exclusion (path regex limited to `issuex/`) preceded by a YAML comment pointing at `docs/errata/01_import_issuex_and_jobqueue.md`. Never edit the copied code to satisfy the linter
If a finding in jobqueue appears, resolve it by path-scoped exclusion too, with the same comment, and list it in the erratum
Append each exclusion (path, linter, reason) to the erratum under the findings list
Diff the config against hub's (TS-01-44): removed rules name hub paths, added rules are only the commented issuex exclusions, nothing else differs
Confirm `golangci-lint run` exits 0 with no findings (TS-01-45, TS-01-22) and `make check` exits 0
done_when: `golangci-lint run` exits 0
every exclusion has a comment naming the erratum file

tasks.title: Add doc.go and the TestExportedAPI golden guard with committed goldens
steps: Create `doc.go`: `package aflib` with only a package doc comment naming github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib, saying it holds the packages shared by the agent-fox programs, with one line each for `issuex` and `jobqueue`. No declarations, no imports

Write `api_test.go` in package `aflib_test` using only the standard library. Testable helpers: discover(root) uses go/build ImportDir (treat *build.NoGoError as not a package), skips testdata, names starting with `.` or `_`, docs, examples and any internal path element, and returns the sorted golden names (root is `aflib`); render(dir) parses GoFiles with parser.ParseFile(ParseComments), calls doc.NewFromFiles (not ParseDir), nils Doc on GenDecl/FuncDecl and Doc/Comment on struct and interface fields, then prints Consts, Vars, Funcs, then each Type followed by its Consts, Vars, Funcs, Methods through format.Node, each declaration followed by a blank line, with no package clause or import path; never exec `go doc`

Add compare/check helpers: a mismatch message names the package, the first differing line (number and both texts) and `make api-golden`; a package without testdata/api/<name>.golden fails naming the package; a golden matching no package fails naming the file; a `-update` flag (flag.Bool) rewrites every discovered golden and removes orphans
Add TestExportedAPI running on the real module root over testdata/api/<name>.golden

Create fixtures under testdata/fixtures/ (a render fixture with expected.golden covering exported/unexported consts, vars, funcs, a type with associated const/var/constructor/methods and all comment kinds; a discovery fixture tree with a, b/c, testdata, .hidden, _tmp, docs, examples, internal/x and a test-only dir; missing-golden and orphan-golden fixtures). Fixture .go files live under testdata so the go tool ignores them

Write TS-01-25, 26, 28, 29, 30 as unit tests over the fixtures; TS-01-32 as a property test using testing/quick or a seeded generator checking determinism and invariance under comment-only and unexported-only mutations; TS-01-3 parsing doc.go and checking aflib.golden is 0 bytes

Generate the goldens with `make api-golden` (produces testdata/api/aflib.golden empty, issuex.golden, jobqueue.golden). Write TS-01-27 and confirm the goldens equal renderings of the source packages at the two source commits (one-off comparison against a render of the source tree)
TS-01-31: in a scratch copy with a stale, a missing and an orphaned golden, run `go test -run TestExportedAPI . -update` then without `-update`; the second run exits 0
Run `make check` and confirm exit 0
done_when: `go test -run TestExportedAPI -count=1 .` passes
testdata/api/aflib.golden is empty

tasks.title: Add the TestDependencies guard and the package-layout check
steps: Write `deps_test.go` in package `aflib_test`, standard library only (its own imports must be stdlib or this module), sharing the discovery helper from api_test.go where useful
Implement a go.mod parser by lines handling `require ( ... )` blocks, single-line `require`, `// indirect` and `replace` in single-line and block form, with no golang.org/x/mod and no network
Implement isStdlib(path): true exactly when the first `/`-separated element contains no dot

Implement checkGoMod: fail naming `go.mod` and the replace directive text; fail naming `go.mod` and the module for a direct (non-indirect) require outside the allowlist {github.com/google/uuid, modernc.org/sqlite} plus modules ruled in under 01-REQ-4.4 (read from task 4's outcome)

Implement checkImports using go/build file lists and parser.ImportsOnly: non-test files of public packages may import stdlib, github.com/google/uuid or packages of this module only (modernc.org/sqlite fails); test files and files of internal/ packages may also import the test allowlist. Messages name the file and the offending import

Add fixtures under testdata/fixtures/deps/ (go.mod variants: single-line and block replace, direct bad require single-line and block, indirect, allowed; fixture packages with good and bad imports) and write unit tests TS-01-33, 34, 35, 36, 38 and a property test TS-01-37 for isStdlib
Add TestDependencies over the committed tree (TS-01-39)
Add a layout test for TS-01-2: `go list ./...` (or discovery) non-internal packages are exactly aflib, aflib/issuex, aflib/jobqueue; no cmd/ directory; any internal/<helper> is listed in the erratum
Run `make check` and confirm exit 0
done_when: `go test -run 'TestDependencies' -count=1 .` passes
failure messages name the file and the offending directive or import

tasks.title: Write reference docs, README and generated docs
steps: Read testdata/api/issuex.golden and jobqueue.golden and the copied package comments so every identifier named in the docs exists
Write docs/api.md: state there is no REST API, map aflib (doc only), issuex and jobqueue with purpose and principal exported identifiers, point to docs/generated/

Write docs/architecture.md: each package's origin (repository and full hash), import graph (neither imports the other; issuex stdlib only; jobqueue stdlib plus uuid; tests also use modernc.org/sqlite), the allowlist and the rule that a new module needs a ruling there first, test layout (tests next to code, root guard tests, goldens in testdata/api/), jobqueue caller contract (caller-owned *sql.DB, WAL and busy_timeout, idempotent handlers), versioning (vX.Y.Z tags, first v0.1.0 cut by a human after both consumers switch, pre-1.0 breaking change bumps the minor version and is recorded in errata), and any internal/ helpers or rulings from task 4
Write docs/cli.md with one line: the repository has no command

Search issuex non-test files for os.Getenv, os.LookupEnv and os.Environ; write docs/configuration.md listing EVERY variable found, its precedence below explicit Options.Token/BaseURL, the `git remote get-url` and `gh` fallbacks, that hub sets everything explicitly, and that jobqueue reads no environment (confirm by search)
Rewrite README.md: the module, both packages, `go get github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib`, `make check`, `make doc`, `make api-golden`, links to docs/ files that exist

Run `make doc` (as steering requires, before finalising docs) and commit docs/generated/aflib.txt, issuex.txt, jobqueue.txt; confirm `git status --porcelain docs/generated` is empty on a second `make doc` (TS-01-43)
Review the docs against TS-01-46, 47, 48, 50 as handoff checks (identifiers exist in goldens, needles present, links resolve); do not commit tests of doc content
Run `make check` and confirm exit 0
done_when: docs/generated contains exactly aflib.txt, issuex.txt and jobqueue.txt
every environment variable read by issuex appears in docs/configuration.md

steps: Read AGENTS.md and .specs/steering.md. Note the section headings and keep a copy of both originals (git show HEAD:<file>) for comparison

In AGENTS.md rewrite only the Repository Layout section: doc.go (root package, doc only), issuex/, jobqueue/, root guard tests and testdata/api/, docs/ and docs/generated/, .specs/, tests living next to the code. Remove agentkit.Config, examples/ and containers/. Leave every other section byte-identical
Make CLAUDE.md byte-identical to AGENTS.md (copy the file; keep a symlink as is if it already is one)

Verify as handoff checks by section-wise diff against the originals (TS-01-51, TS-01-52) and `cmp AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md`; do not commit tests of doc content
Run `make check` and confirm exit 0
done_when: `cmp AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md` reports no difference

steps: Write and run TS-01-53: fresh clone of the repository alone, run `make check`; confirm fmt, vet, lint (or skip message) and test-short run in order, the GitLab smoke test is skipped, TestExportedAPI and TestDependencies pass, exit 0

Write and run TS-01-54 in a scratch copy: change an exported signature in jobqueue, `make check` fails naming jobqueue, the first differing line and `make api-golden`; run `make api-golden`; `make check` then exits 0

Write and run TS-01-55 in a scratch copy: add a replace directive to go.mod, confirm `make check` fails naming go.mod and the directive; revert, add a non-allowlisted import to a non-test issuex file, confirm it fails naming file and import
Write and run TS-01-56: `make doc`, confirm exactly aflib.txt, issuex.txt, jobqueue.txt and a clean `git status --porcelain docs/generated`

Trace 01-PATH-1 to 01-PATH-4 through the real Makefile and tests: confirm `check` calls fmt, vet, lint, test-short; test-short runs TestExportedAPI and TestDependencies; `api-golden` passes -update to the test; `doc` uses the same package discovery and names as the golden test; no stub remains

Confirm `make check` exits 0 on the final tree and the full gate (`make check-release`) is left to the user, noted in the handoff
